title: The Copper Letter
author: Marguerite Sandoval
blurb: Odile Eastwick, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
